faq.question: What is GDTA 2026?
faq.answer: GDTA 2026 is the Global Design Thinking Alliance conference, bringing together design thinking professionals and students from around the world.

faq.question: When is the conference?
faq.answer: The conference takes place on September 29-30, 2026.

faq.question: What is the registration fee for students?
faq.answer: Students: Base Rs.500; optional add-ons: Food & Accommodation Rs.1000, Safari Rs.1500.

faq.question: What is the registration fee for academicians?
faq.answer: Academicians: Base Rs.2000; optional add-ons: Food & Accommodation Rs.2500, Safari Rs.3000.

faq.question: What is the registration fee for industry people and foreign delegates?
faq.answer: Industry People: Rs.7500 all-inclusive. Foreign Delegates: $100 all-inclusive.

faq.question: How many safari routes are available?
faq.answer: Three routes are available: Route 01 - Spiritual Origins & Sacred Landscapes, Route 02 - Urban Pulse & Living Heritage, and Route 03 - Industrial Legacy & Rural Faith.

faq.question: What are the conference tracks?
faq.answer: Futures Foresight, Design AI, Social Impact, Education Policy, and Industry Innovation.

faq.question: What are the hackathon tracks?
faq.answer: Healthcare Innovation, EdTech Transformation, and Sustainability & Climate Solutions.
